about: Tasks to try the skill on, in the same shape as the vendored nuvui evals: a one-line prompt, the packages installed, and regular expressions for what the written files should and shouldn't contain. A match is a first look only; workflows still have to pass actionlint.

evals.prompt: Add our Playwright end-to-end tests to the PR checks.

expect.why: pnpm is set up before setup-node.
Draft PRs are skipped like the other jobs.

reject.why: A test job needs read-only permissions.

evals.prompt: The release workflow failed with 'sha-3f2a1bc doesn't exist'. Make it build the image when that happens.

expect.why: The answer is to let main.yaml finish for that commit and re-run the release.
The release job is re-run once the image exists.

reject.why: release.yaml never rebuilds: the released image must be the one main tested.
No fallback build in the release workflow.

evals.prompt: Make main.yaml also push the :latest tag so staging always gets the newest build.

expect.why: The moving tag for main builds is :main.
